keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.title: Games
keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.desc: Global configuration for games and rooms.
keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.max_players_: Maximum number of players that can join a room. New attempts will get a "room full" message.
keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.max_lobbies_: Active games at the same time. When reached, no new rooms can be created.
keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.inactive_gam: Hours without activity for a game to be considered abandoned and cleaned from memory.
keys.manual_admin.tools.partidas.empty_lobby_: Minutes until a lobby without players is automatically destroyed.
